ReasonCodes.title: Adjustment reason codes
ReasonCodes.body: The catalog of reasons inventory adjustments are justified with: code, name, category and whether a note is required. What you maintain here appears as the picker when recording an adjustment, so every stock change stays linked to a named reason. Archiving removes a reason from the pickers without touching history: old adjustments keep their reason.
